test_title: PYST 4: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held on: 17th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Six friends A, B, C, D, E, and F are sitting in a straight horizontal row facing north. B sits between F and C. E sits third to the right of C. D is sitting immediately to the left of E. Who sits second to the right of B?
solution:
**Six friends:** A, B, C, D, E, and F.

(1) E sits third to the right of C. 

(2) D is sitting immediately to the left of E. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d4c768e27568cd6533d4f2fa4073bdba3dd16ea3cd9b78bf1533a62aa6c5fcf.png] 

(3) B sits between F and C. 

Thus, the final seating arrangement is as follows,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8836a174cfd52c4087fa6c3773d0ccdfdc6777c62956ef46281eb29e424d1ef0.png] 

Hence, **A **is second to the right of B.
